name: Tacto (Tacto Technology GmbH)
what: AI-based procurement and supply-chain operating system for industrial SMEs.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; Visionaries Club named in the Mar 2022 seed and the Dec 2023 round; Seed Fund I in Tacto's shareholder lists of 2020-08-24 and 2026-04-15 (North Data).
membership.quote: with participation from UVC Partners, Visionaries Club, and angel investors

entry.quote: also 24/08/2020 Tacto Technology GmbH: “Liste der Gesellschafter“

funding_rounds.note: Capital EUR 25,002 -> 30,165 registered 2020-08-22; shareholder list 2020-08-24 names Visionaries Club Seed Fund I (per the fund's North Data page).
BI (Nov 2023) calls it 'The company's $5.6 million seed round, in March 2022'.
'Existing investors Visionaries Club, Cherry Ventures, and UVC Partners also joined'. Round word from BI (2023-11-03): 'Sequoia is set to lead Tacto's Series A round'.

valuation.quote: None priced; BI (Nov 2023) reported only a rumoured ~$300M for a prospective later deal, not a closed round.

graduation.quote: Sequoia is set to lead Tacto's Series A round

notes: EARLIER CHECK: Visionaries Club Seed Fund I is named in Tacto's shareholder list of 2020-08-24 (the fund's North Data page lists 'also 24/08/2020 Tacto Technology GmbH'), following a capital increase registered 2020-08-22, weeks after the company's registration (2020-07-16). So the first check predates the announced Mar 2022 seed; that 2020 raise has no round name in any source. If a named round is required, the earliest named round with Visionaries is the Seed (Mar 2022, tech.eu/BI), which matches Cherry's row. Either way the stage is seed or earlier and the Dec 2023 EUR 50M Series A (Sequoia/Index) is the graduation. BI gives the seed as $5.6M, tech.eu as EUR 5.3M (same round).
